review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR) and the decrypted engine image (CS_ENGINE_IMAGE); the report is derived from the recorded log plus a second production pass recorded in hardpoint-price.json. MEASURED (identifiers, addresses, counts and digests only; provenance static, never verified_original): the rocket id mapper 0x4440f0 sends rocket ids 0..10 to weapon records wep_05, wep_06, wep_07, wep_08, wep_09, wep_15, wep_13, wep_12, wep_10, wep_11, wep_14 and answers none for id 11 and above (T452-R.03-A); a slot's stack count is the record's CLUSTER_SIZE copied to (record + 0x210) + 0xc at 0x4baa17, not AMMO_LIMIT, which parses to record + 0x18 with default 50.0 at 0x5ad805 and has no found consumer (T452-R.03-B); the effect-class media ids map through the measured FIRE/FLYOUT/IMPACT/DESTROY_ANIMATION blocks, the launch sound is the record's own FIRE>SOUND[0], and a record without it is silent (T452-R.03-C); the sixteen catalogued records declare no requirement or permission key, so the empty equipment rule set is the measured value (T452-R.03-D); and the purchase surface prices each enabled rocket box a flat 480 weight / 410 cost (E 2260/2261 at 0x40b2ff, the totals at 0x405550/0x405680 summing the record+0x34/+0x38 box counts), reads no rocket-type-dependent value, and fills the side's draft slots with ids 0/1 or none 11 through E 2245 at 0x40ad0f; the Instant Action gate table at 0x619efc carries twelve rows whose first dword is the availability threshold and whose second dword no code reads. NOT CLAIMED: any original-run behavior (retail is read access, no agent ran the original); a per-type ordnance mass or cost table (none was found — the measured value is the flat per-box price and the absence, not an invented table); the AMMO_LIMIT consumer (negative static search, not proof of absence); the FLYOUT>SOUND consumer; the runtime stack decrement; the weight unit's conversion to kilograms; the gate table's second dword's meaning; the sound-name to wave mapping; the purchase callbacks 2243/2230 and handlers 5058/2037, which remain unread; and the runtime registration step, which is task T452-RUNTIME-REGISTER's. The claim is implemented: a code and test pass awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
